parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must not disclose personal information of users without consent or in breach of a lawful contract, as this constitutes an offence under the IT Act 2000, Section 72A.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the document explicitly states that intermediaries must not disclose personal information without consent or in breach of a lawful contract.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries and platforms handling user data.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the legal penalty for disclosure of personal information in breach of a lawful contract.

parsed_entries.requirement: No court shall take cognizance of any offence under the IT Act 2000, Section 72, except on a complaint made by an officer authorised in this behalf by the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that complaints regarding breaches of confidentiality and privacy must be made to the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to entities handling electronic records and personal information.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the procedural requirement for reporting breaches to the designated national agency.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team shall serve as the national agency for performing functions in the area of cybersecurity, including incident response and protection of critical information infrastructure.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the document states that the national agency for cybersecurity is responsible for incident response and protection of critical information infrastructure.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to entities involved in cybersecurity and critical information infrastructure.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the role of the national agency in cybersecurity functions.

parsed_entries.requirement: The national nodal agency designated under the IT Act 2000 shall be responsible for all measures including Research and Development relating to protection of Critical Information Infrastructure.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that the national nodal agency is responsible for Research and Development in the protection of Critical Information Infrastructure.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to entities designated as national nodal agencies.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the responsibility of the national nodal agency in protecting Critical Information Infrastructure.
